rules: Production routing code must not contain dialogue phrase catalogs or entity allowlists.
Production routing code must not contain regex-based conversational intent or entity routing.
The only semantic map may define one abstract task meaning per action; it may not contain utterance examples.
Natural-language examples belong in evaluation data and tests, never in production routing rules.
The routing model may choose only direct, retrieve, catalog, or uncertain; uncertain must fail closed to retrieval.
Retrieval queries must preserve the literal current turn as the ranking query.
Generative models must not create routing decisions or standalone retrieval queries in the hot path.
